Container.Name: gpodder-sync
Container.Overview: gpodder.net-compatible podcast sync server for AntennaPod. It does no authentication itself: run it behind Caddy (basic_auth) or Caddy + Authelia, which authenticate clients and forward the username in a header. Requests from anything other than the trusted proxy are refused. No port is published on purpose; only the proxy should reach it.
Container.Description: gpodder.net-compatible podcast sync server for AntennaPod, authenticated by your reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy IP
Config.Description: Exact IP of your Caddy container on the shared network (give Caddy a fixed IP). Never the whole subnet.

Config.Name: Proxy user header
Config.Description: Header carrying the authenticated username. Remote-User matches Authelia; use the same name in Caddy's header_up for basic_auth.
